# Derivation Type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:DerivationType`](gmeow-DerivationType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/DerivationType>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)

The kind of creative derivation relating a source and product — a VALUE vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses). Cover, remix, sample, arrangement, transcription, quotation, and others are co-equal seeds.

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:DerivationType`](gmeow-DerivationType.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
